headline: Intel, SK Hynix shares jump on report they're discussing U.S. memory chip manufacturing
detail: This is positive news for the semiconductor sector, suggesting potential for increased domestic production and reduced supply chain risks. It could provide a boost to your chip-heavy portfolio.
rec: Consider adding to existing chip exposure like SMH if it shows strength, or initiating a new position in QCOM (entry 187.31-187.13, stop 186.42) as a potential beneficiary.

headline: Yield on 10-year Treasury hovers above 5% as investors await Fed decision
detail: High bond yields increase borrowing costs and make future earnings of growth stocks, especially tech, less attractive. This is a significant headwind for your concentrated, margin-fueled portfolio.
rec: Watch your stops on QQQ, SMH, and especially your leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) very closely. Be ready to trim if stops are hit.

headline: Ukraine's message to Asian nations: your chips are turning up in Russian missiles
detail: This highlights geopolitical risks and potential for further export controls or supply chain disruptions in the semiconductor industry. It adds uncertainty to the global chip market.
rec: No immediate trade, but remain vigilant for increased volatility or negative news flow impacting the chip sector. This adds a layer of risk to your holdings.
